subject: phy-u-fund
title: PHY.U.FUND.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-17 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One), opening Braxton's elaboration of 'the spectacle-diversion sequence of American progressionalism — involving what this phenomenon has posed for western affinity dynamics and expansion as well as creativity.' (C)PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what the physical universe fundamental requires to produce composite continuance, when the culture's actual generative apparatus is spectacle-diversion. SPT-DYM (spectacle dynamics), S-PROJ (source projection), and PRI-INFO (principle information) feed the subject. The crossing routes through RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) as a central hub, with SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) and ACT-T (actual terms) as parallel inputs. C-CONT outputs to MT-INFO (multi-information). RE-ST (restructuralism) is a peripheral output. Structural argument: the physical-universe fundamental's path to composite continuance is mediated through reality-initiative-traits — Braxton's structural claim that culture continues only when initiative traits are actually generated, not merely simulated through spectacle. The presence of spectacle-dynamics as an upstream feed of the subject (rather than as a parallel resistance) registers Braxton's diagnostic: the spectacle-diversion syndrome is already constitutive of how western culture perceives its physical-universe ground.
